summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, attaching a news release reporting Q3 2026 production of 69,665 gold equivalent ounces versus 72,217 GEO in Q2 2026 and 72,462 GEO in Q3 2025, with nine-month output of 214,754 GEO against 281,000-305,000 GEO annual guidance. The release also notes approval of a 30% Séguéla plant expansion targeting over 200,000 ounces annually from H2 2028 and an adjacent 190 km² Bambadji concession acquisition. This is a routine operating update, not a special situation; watch only for cost and guidance revisions.
